inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: Primary caregiver is missing 9 hours of annual training for his/her evaluation period. Primary caregiver only has 21 hours of training from the required 30 hours available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children: During inspection, it was observed that the operation has a pink oleander plant accessible in the outdoor play area. This plant is known to be poisonous if ingested. Photo taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Poisonous Plants Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §747.3501(6))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects: The operation has not validated their people list within the past year. The last time their people list was validated was on 3/7/24.      This was corrected at inspection after child care regulation  inspector validated the people list on behalf of the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - Once a year listed family homes, licensed, and registered child care homes must validate list of subjects (26 TAC §745.651(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: A child's file is missing the health care professional statement. The child does not attend school yet.

AP Renewal background checks submitted -No later than 5 yrs from date last submitted subjects initial or renewal fingerprint-based criminal hist check: The operation failed to timely submit the information required to conduct a renewal background check for an individual (household member) who had a fingerprint check. Last fingerprint check for the individual is dated 4/20/2019.     The renewal background check must be submitted within 5 years (date to date) of the previous check for an individual who had a fingerprint check.     This was corrected at inspection after primary caregiver completed/submitted a paper Child Care Licensing Request for Background Check form 2971 for the household member.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Renewal background checks submitted -No later than 5 yrs from date last submitted subjects initial or renewal fingerprint-based criminal hist check (26 TAC §745.621(b)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation did not practice a fire drill for the month of April. No documentation of the fire emergency drill was available for review.     This was corrected at inspection after a fire drill was practiced to make up for the month of April.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR: The primary caregiver had an expired first aid certification on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1007(5))

occurrences.finding: Permit Required: The operation has not renewed the daycare permit as of 4/1/0/22.
Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The primary caregiver's  CPR/First Aid training has expired as of 3/2021 and will need to be renewed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))
